strings.2: Marry Bjoern to Ragna. After the wedding, assign them the empty house on the eastern shore.
strings.3: Ask Ragna and Bjoern to have a child.

briefings.01:
Take HALLDOR, for example. 

<usericon:2,1>

His profession is Extractor, and he gathers wood. He enjoys his work. He has a wife and a young child waiting for him at home after work.

Every villager is a unique character. They all look different, they have different names, different professional developments and individual skills and needs. And you can influence all these things except for their looks!
briefings.02:
This is Gunnhild. She is the happy woman at Halldor's side, and the pair have a little girl called Grimmhild ...

<usericon:1,88,192>

SOCIAL GROUP
If you move the cursor over Gunnhild, a card with her name and current profession appears underneath the mouse pointer. When you select her, the character panel in the bottom right corner of the screen shows her home, work place, partner and children. Clicking the partner, a child or a building in that panel selects it straight away. This way you can see at a glance who belongs to her, where she lives and where she works.

Buildings work the same way: when you select a building, its panel shows all the characters who live or work in it.
briefings.03:
This is BJOERN. He is a scout and he is fed up with erecting signposts all day long ... 

<usericon:2,6>

He'd like to have a wife as well, to live in a dwelling and add to the Viking tribe. He doesn't like his profession, and he'd much rather sit and fish all day. 

Give BJOERN a new profession! 

If a character has a “Rename” button beside their name, you can use it to enter a new name and confirm with ENTER. Bjoern's name is fixed in this tutorial, so this exercise changes only his profession. 
Give him the profession of a fisherman.
briefings.04:
The next thing he should do is look out for a bride.
Further inland master carpenter Kalf is living with his beautiful and intelligent daughter Ragna. 

<usericon:1,87,149>

Marry BJOERN to RAGNA. Marriage may move the couple into Ragna's existing home. After the wedding, select Bjoern and assign him to the empty house on the eastern shore, near where he first stood. Ragna moves with him. Once they live in that house, ask the couple to have a child.

Note: Marrying is not always that easy. Some Vikings are so focused on their tasks that they won't even notice the approaches of another character, or they may even choose a different partner. If you experience problems with two people who you think should love one another, send them both away from the others and order at least one of them to marry!
briefings.06:
NEEDS

All your Vikings have the same needs as real humans. They have to eat, sleep and talk, and some of them even need religion to be content. If the villagers have such a need, they'll do anything to fulfil it as soon as possible. If they are hungry for example, they'll stop working to look for some food in their surroundings. If they find some, they will go there and eat it. They will only return to their work when they are no longer hungry. 
You should make sure that your Vikings can satisfy their needs quickly, so they can carry on with their work. 

Your Vikings will tell you what they think is important via the messages in the top left corner of the screen! Messages with a red seal are urgent, an orange seal marks important ones and a green seal less important ones. By holding SHIFT and right-clicking a message, you can delete all the displayed messages.
briefings.07:
HEROES

Some Vikings differ from your civilian population: They are stronger and faster than ordinary Vikings, they don't get hungry and they don't need to sleep. They don't have a profession either, because their profession is to be a HERO. Their exploration radius is almost as wide as that of a scout. Heroes mainly live a solitary life and there are not many of them in the world, but one of them will accompany you from the very start of the game. He is BJARNI - the son of a legendary Viking king of the past. 

<usericon:2,7>

Beware! In some campaign missions, a hero's death can mean defeat. In this tutorial, if Bjarni dies, you get another attempt.

SUBJECTS WINDOW

If you lose a hero or another Viking, open the subjects window (F2) or click the "Subjects" button on the bottom bar. There you can search for your characters according to different categories and select them.
briefings.08:
WOLVES

As mentioned before, your Vikings can only die of starvation or injuries in battle. Wolves and other wild animals therefore represent a great danger.
With a hero at your side, they should not be a problem for you though ...

<usericon:1,225,156>

Fight the wolves in the swamp with Bjarni: select him, click on him with the RIGHT MOUSE BUTTON (or press SPACE), choose the order "Attack Animal" from the action menu and click on a wolf with the LEFT MOUSE BUTTON!
briefings.09:
Unfortunately you have not succeeded, because Bjarni fell victim to the wolves. 
In a mission that requires the hero to survive, this would mean defeat.

We'll give you another chance and revive the hero ...
